style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: Arjuna speaks wisdom but acts in grief
The wise do not grieve for either the dead or the living
Krishna corrects Arjuna's words, not his feelings

angle_en: Wisdom and grief do not match in Arjuna
angle_hi: अर्जुन की बातें और उनका शोक एक नहीं हैं

en.intro: Krishna looks at Arjuna's words and actions, finding a mismatch. Listen for the gap between what Arjuna says and what he does.
en.notice: Krishna points out the mismatch: Arjuna speaks like a wise man while grieving for those who need no grief.
en.next: Krishna then reminds Arjuna that neither he nor the kings will ever cease to exist.
en.meaning: The Blessed Lord says: You grieve for what should not be grieved for, yet speak words of wisdom. The wise do not grieve for the dead or the living.

hi.intro: श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुन की बातों और उनके कर्मों के बीच एक अंतर देखते हैं। सुनिए, वे क्या कहते हैं।
hi.meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे । गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः ।
hi.notice: श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुन की बातों और उनके कर्मों के बीच एक अंतर देखते हैं। अर्जुन ज्ञान की बातें कर रहा है, जबकि शोक कर रहा है उन लोगों का जिनके लिए शोक करना उचित नहीं है।
hi.next: श्रीकृष्ण अगले श्लोक में बताते हैं कि वे, अर्जुन और ये राजा कभी भी समाप्त नहीं होंगे।

en.intro: Krishna looks at Arjuna's words and actions, finding a mismatch. Listen for the gap between what Arjuna says and what he does.
en.body: The Blessed Lord says: You grieve for what should not be grieved for, yet speak words of wisdom. The wise do not grieve for the dead or the living. Krishna points out the mismatch: Arjuna speaks like a wise man while grieving for those who need no grief. Krishna then reminds Arjuna that neither he nor the kings will ever cease to exist.
